integrity: The nonempty geometric-base schemes are identified by exact projective-chart elimination on complete orbit representatives; a finite-morphism degree calculation is supplied. The known ambient census is replicated for reproducibility. Independent external validation has not been performed.
limitations: The geometric-base refinement is for the known 864 all-smooth binary cubic nets and rational projective equivalence. The ambient 864 count and orbit decomposition are not novel. Unindexed common-base computations could already encode the refinement.
title: Two Frobenius-thickened base orbits among all-smooth cubic nets over \(\mathbf F_2\)
